card.title: FORMOSA
card.text: The main force attacking the Philippines came from the island of Formosa.

Text.SourceString: The main force attacking the Philippines came from the island of Formosa.
Text.LocalizedString: The main force attacking the Philippines came from the island of Formosa.

value.value: Our troops are ready to make a landing in Lingayen Gulf. Speed is of the essence so we don’t get bogged down on the beaches.

value.value: Our captured airfields in northern Luzon are coming in handy.

value.value: We can make landings in multiple locations, making it difficult for our enemy to defend effectively.

value.value: The enemy is sending sorties of B-17s from Australia. You must act fast.
